topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: The walls seem to shift subtly as I walk the familiar corridors, now lined with unfamiliar faces. I hold my papers close, the edges curling a little from the slight dampness of my grasp. My steps are quieter than usual, as if whispering to the floorboards, asking them to not betray my passage. The new department hums a different tune, the air charged with the energy of tasks I've yet to learn. I nod politely to the new colleagues, my smile a little tighter than I mean it to be. It feels like I'm stepping into a page of a book I haven’t read, each line a mystery, each word a challenge. I find my new desk, a blank slate in a sea of burgeoning projects. Here, I suppose, is where the new chapter begins.
